Photo 1 shows the back of the same white console, with a hand holding it. The Sony logo is visible at the bottom right corner.

Photo 2 shows a white console box wrapped in plastic, with a PS5 DualSense controller placed on top. The PlayStation logo is visible on the box. The console and controller appear new or well-maintained.

The seller claims 'Slim PS5 with 10 games and pad', but no games are shown in the photos.

risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting into the PS5 UI, and running a game from the disc or digital library.

risks.risk: The 10 games may not be included or may be digital-only with no physical copies or account access.
risks.proof: Photos of the 10 game cases or digital codes, or a screenshot of the games installed on the console.

risks.risk: The console may be a refurbished or used unit with hidden wear or damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A 360-degree video of the console showing all sides, ports, and condition, including the interior if possible.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used with unknown condition

risks.risk: The controller may be non-functional or have battery issues.
risks.proof: A video showing the controller connecting to the console and being used to play a game.

Photos or video of the 10 games included (physical cases or digital codes).
360-degree video of the console and controller showing all sides and condition.
